_comment: SEED/test-grade server-entry spec corpus for the G2 lane (po-av01j.3). Hand-authored, sufficient for e2e tests only. The PRODUCTION corpus is authored through the LLM spec factory with human review; these seeds are deliberately small and conservative.

seed: middleware/handler identities of the mainstream rate-limiting libraries (express-rate-limit, chi Throttle, tollbooth, slowapi, flask-limiter)
seed: middleware/handler identities that provide a degraded-response path under overload or dependency failure
